atoms.sound: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
The grass is always greener on the other side.

atoms.text: Mihika is comforting Collin since he just got into a fight with his best friend.

instruction.text: Follow the dialogue and select the missing sayings and expressions.

atoms.b: Wow, I can’t believe he said those mean things about you!
Right? I honestly don’t get it... What made him say those hurtful things?
((++Your_guess_is_as_good_as_mine No_pain,_no_gain)). I wish I could tell you.
I’m just so disappointed. I never did anything to him. Or maybe I did? I honestly can’t remember anything though.
((++Cut_yourself_some_slack Get_a_taste_of_your_own_medicine)). He’s been hanging out with Dylan. You know that he’s known for gossiping.
Also true. But there has to be a reason for it though, right? Maybe I should try calling him...
If I was you, I would probably give myself some time to think about it. But it’s entirely up to you. Do whatever ((++floats_your_boat rocks_your_world)) and what you feel good with.
Yeah... maybe you’re right. I’ll sleep on it and think of what I want to do tomorrow.
((++Hang_in_there All_that_glitters_is_not_gold)). You aren’t alone in this.
